description: This is a JUnit 5 test class for the RegistrationMessageFilter, verifying message filtering logic against registration message format specifications. It contains test methods for device ID mismatch, missing device ID, missing action, tenant-only target validation, and matching device ID.

classes.name: RegistrationMessageFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of RegistrationMessageFilter.verify method against various registration message scenarios.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsDeviceIdMismatch
methods.description: Tests that a registration message with a device ID different from the link target fails validation.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Tests that a registration message missing a device ID fails validation.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsMissingAction
methods.description: Tests that a registration message missing an action (subject) fails validation.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForTenantOnlyLinkTarget
methods.description: Tests that a valid tenant-level registration message passes validation.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForMatchingDevice
methods.description: Tests that a registration message with matching device ID and link target passes validation.

methods.name: getResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Helper method to create ResourceIdentifier objects with tenant and optional device parameters.

methods.name: givenAMessageHavingProperties
methods.description: Helper method to create a mock Message with specified device ID and action properties.
